notes.note: Reviewed the consent repair from the mounted per-publisher Settings controls and disclosure decision through PUT config authorization, canonical persistence, inventory acknowledgement and Full admission. Off is saved before acknowledging; DNT and pending Full are displayed separately from saved choice. Environment is a default capped at Lite, legacy writes translate without a second persisted authority, standard paired devices can lower and cannot raise, reset preserves choices, Kontour Full is unavailable. Focused route/UI/service and activation tests executed; browser gallery is separate rendered evidence, not release qualification. Other unrelated telemetry delivery claims remain unchanged.

Reviewed the bounded telemetry status and config mutation delta: publisher source and userChoice fields are additive, environment is a default reason, the operator-only source projection remains compatible, and raises require operator/access:manage while reductions remain available to standard paired devices. The existing acknowledgement protocol is unchanged. Other API contracts are unchanged.

Reviewed telemetry set/status against the real command and focused CLI tests: contract names remain stable, environment defaults cannot grant Full, and Kontour Full fails with explicit guidance before a request. Other CLI commands are unchanged.

Reviewed telemetry persistence and write authorization against loader, merge and real route tests: tiers are canonical after migration, alias writes translate without persistence, standard devices can withdraw but cannot raise, and reset preserves choices. Destinations and all unrelated settings are unchanged.

Reviewed resolver and service tests for STATION_TELEMETRY_TIER and the legacy boolean aliases: valid environment defaults are capped at Lite and report environment; stored choices and DNT retain precedence. Other environment contracts are unchanged.
